Charlie spelled "ie' on cover sleeve and "ey" on disc label of side A; B side label has a space where the e would be - "Charl  y."

CT in runout indicates a pressing by Columbia - Terre Haute. Besides pressing plant info and minor differences in matrix runout, this label looks exactly like (another Discogs entry)

Recorded in early 1941, Charlie Christian died at a young age on March 2, 1942 about a year after these recordings were made.
Jerry Newman recorded them on a portable disc cutter, prior to the days of tape recording.  This info was taken from the last two paragraph's of the liner notes.
